title: Unknown or invalid ids return 200 with an empty, null or made-up record instead of 400/404
description: When you ask for, change or delete a product, cart or user that doesn't exist (or use letters instead of a number), the system answers 'OK, success' and sends back nothing - or even pretends to update item 9999. It should clearly say 'not found' or 'invalid number'. Apps relying on it show blank pages or think a change worked when it didn't.
steps: Send GET https://fakestoreapi.com/products/9999 -> 200 with an EMPTY body
expected: 400 Bad request (as documented in the spec) or 404 Not Found with a JSON error message.
actual: 200 OK with an empty body, 'null', or the sent data echoed back as if item 9999 existed.
notes: Non-numeric ids are already rejected with 400 on DELETE /products, /carts/{id}, /users/{id} - GET /products/{id} is the odd one out.
